messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xx/timeouts + upstream 429s observed at API edge starting 2026-03-14T20:22:00Z. Affected: /v1/stream, /v1/embed. Paging primary oncall.

ben (oncall): Oncall ben here, looking. Pulling up dashboards and runbook. Which components first spotted this?

lina (sre): Grafana: errors rising in us-west-2 and eu-central. Router returns 502s; auth/quota service shows surge of 429s ~10s before gateway 5xx. There's also a sharp increase in redis kv misses around same time.

jordan (eng): We rolled a tenant quota patch at 20:15 that added a fallback policy and a new "apply_to": "all_tenants" field in the template. Deploy id: qcfg-2026-03-14-2015. I suspect the wildcard scope is the culprit (should've been explicit list).

deploy-bot: qcfg-2026-03-14-2015 deployed to quota-service and api-gateway at 2026-03-14T20:15:33Z. Payload excerpt: `{"quota_enforce": true, "apply_to": "all_tenants", "default_rps": 2}`

tasha (product): CS reports enterprise customers experiencing interrupted streams (clients see 502 mid-stream) and higher client-side retries. Several accounts on dedicated plans reported failures.

lina (sre): Quick numbers: 18% error rate over last 3m. Error mix: 58% 502 gateway, 27% 504 timeout, 15% 429 from quota-service. Streaming sessions drop ~20% mid-run. Redis miss rate spiked 8x.

ben (oncall): Immediate mitigation options:
- revert qcfg-2026-03-14-2015 (rollback)
- flip circuit-breaker to bypass quota checks for premium tenants
- temporarily increase quota default to high value and add per-tenant override
- drain unhealthy gateway pods
Which do we want first? I'll start rollback unless someone objects.

jordan (eng): rollback queued. Command:
```
POST https://admin.internal/api/v1/deploys/rollback
{ "deploy_id": "qcfg-2026-03-14-2015" }
```

lina (sre): While rollback runs, I'll enable per-tenant bypass for known premium tenant ids and raise default_rps to 1000 for internal proxies.

cs-bot: Notifying CS: affected tenants list being compiled, will send targeted note to impacted accounts. Priority paths: streaming L7 customers.

lina (sre): logs (snip):
```
[20:21:40] quota-check: tenant=* -> key=global_wildcard -> reject 429 (default rps=2)
[20:21:41] router: upstream quota 429 -> mapped to 502 for client stream req
[20:21:43] redis: connection pool starved -> kv miss
[20:21:44] client_retry: exponential backoff overwhelmed -> inflight climbs
```

ben (oncall): Rollback started. Doing canary reverse -> 50% -> 100%. Monitoring health checks.

deploy-bot: rollback for qcfg-2026-03-14-2015 initiated by ben (oncall). Phases: canary -> 50% -> 100% (eta ~5m).

jordan (eng): Also pushing quick fix: require `apply_to` to be a non-wildcard in config lint and add a pre-deploy hook that runs a synthetic quota-check smoke test.

lina (sre): Temporary configs applied: `circuit_breaker.bypass_tenants=["acct_premium_1","acct_premium_2"]`, `default_rps=1000` on internal path. Also started draining 4 pods with >10% 5xx.

tasha (product): Sending short customer update now (CS drafted). We'll follow up with postmortem and remediation timeline.

ben (oncall): Rollback completed at ~20:20:40Z per deploy-bot. Observed errors drop: overall 5xx down from 18% -> 2.4% in 4m. Streaming reconnects dropping.

lina (sre): Verifying traces: quota-service 429s back to baseline; redis miss rate returning to normal. Root cause: template allowed wildcard tenant scope and default_rps=2 too low for production traffic.

jordan (eng): Post-incident actions I'm taking:
- PR to config-lint to disallow `apply_to: all_tenants` without explicit opt-in + manual approver
- add a 1m synthetic quota-check during deploys which simulates 500 concurrent tenants
- change default_rps floor to 100 for new policies
PR: internal/ops/config#912

lina (sre): Runbook updates:
- add step to check for wildcard scope in quota patches
- add explicit step for circuit-breaker bypass list and a template for temporary whitelist
- tune alerting: separate metric for quota-service 429 spike and gateway 502/504 rise to avoid duplicate pages

tasha (product): Customer impact summary: ~30 enterprise streams impacted for ~6 minutes; multiple premium customers saw degraded experience. CS will propose credits if requested. Drafted message posted to INC ticket.

ben (oncall): handing off to jordan and lina for postmortem. I'll keep monitoring for 1hr then sign off.

pagerduty: If unresolved after 30m escalate to secondary oncall.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated -> status: mitigated. timeline 20:22 -> 20:26. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 for follow-ups.

--- end of thread ---
